body:
Since this is my first report, I'll share a little bit of who I am (drug-wise): This little town is just like every other small town on mud ball. I'll give you the beginning of my chemical history (2004-2005).
2004 - Seven years ago I was 15, super athletic and started taking 75mg doses of ephedrine. At the time, I didn't think I was doing it to get high. I thought I was using it for athletics and staying in shape. Now that I look back, it was probably 60%/40%(athletics/mind altering effects).
A little less than a year later in 2005 (16yo) I found some blue pills at my grandma's house. To this day, I don't know why my 16 year old self started taking Vicodin/Lortab. It was the best feeling in world at the time. After a couple months of taking them, I noticed myself getting weak and slipping away from the world I worked my ass off for. Well that's how the addict, lying dormant was brought to life like a sack of soggy sea monkeys

SUBOXONE REPORT STARTS HERE:
This report may be a little off topic. Bear with me. This is my first experience report. The first time I came across Suboxone, I was cleaning a room in a relatives motel. The bottle said: Buprenorphine/Naloxone 8/2. Inside the bottle contained 18 orange Suboxone sublingual tablets. I remember hearing about Bupe on a harm reduction forum. I wasnt 100% positive on the identity of the little, hexagon shaped, gift from modern science so I decided to google it. I was elated when my guess was confirmed. I had a hangover from hell on this, particular, morning. I NEEDED something, almost any mind altering substance (Except marijuana - I dont like marijuana due to the fact my mind/body chemistry converts weed into a dissociative and puts me in a stupor.)
T+0h:00m - I do as the bottle dictates and take 2 (16mg) sublingually.
T+0:55 - Becoming somewhat upset. I'm beginning to think Suboxone just wasnt my cup of tea.
T+1:05 - I've got two more rooms to clean. Time to get off my ass. I stand up and start walking to the motel room with all my supplies. As I was approach the dirty room I notice something. I feel great! The feeling I got from the Bupe was like a theoretical combo of a less euphoric form of Methadone/the perfect, selective serotonin/norepenephrine inhibitor, type of anti-depressant (My day has just turned into one of those cheesy antidepressant advertisements on T.V.).
T+3:15 - I'm done cleaning the rooms. The 16mg of subs had me more motivated than I had been in quite a while.
T+5:30 - I'm home, feeling so mellow (Likely, due to the 4 benadryl capsules to potentiate The Buprenorphine).
T+6:00 - I'm in my comfortable, lounging pants thinking about nodding off for a while.
In my opinion, the primary 'pro' of Suboxone is; I can feel how I want to feel at any time. I can go from a comfortable, noddy, buzz to a mellowish, speedy feeling
.
Present day -(Fall 2011) - I've had my own Suboxone script for 3 weeks. Today I got my weekly script, 21 tablets, for $27.75. I couldnt afford this new habit if it wasnt for my Insurance. Next week the pharmacy is ordering me some sublingal Suboxone films couple benadryl after giving the bupe time to dissolve sublingualy.
